ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 3:1 low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white/grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white/grey marbled clusters concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe; small white clusters localized at the far left distal tip; solid black pigmentation mapping across the proximal and medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with peaks of 5-15 pixel amplitude distributed across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory fitting the trailing edge from the medial region to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of circular high-contrast white clusters on the distal tip of the left lobe and scattered through the marbled area of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the right lobe, particularly in the lower-distal quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentric swirling pigmentation pattern ('eye' pattern) located in the lower-central portion of the right lobe.
